observations: Front view of a solar panel.
Half-cut cell design with a horizontal split in the middle.
Watermark 'SOBOBO LUMINARIES' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' visible on the image.
Cells are arranged in 6 columns and 20 rows (10 in the top section, 10 in the bottom).

claims.evidence: No brand logo or 'Canadian Solar' markings are visible on the front of the panel in photo 0.
Wattage ratings are found on the rear specification label, which is not pictured.
A visual count of the cells in photo 0 confirms 6 columns and 20 rows of half-cut cells, totaling 120.

risks.risk: The panel may be a generic brand or have a lower wattage than claimed (500W is high for 120 cells).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification label on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: Internal cell damage or micro-cracks that reduce output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of the Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) in clear sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification label on the back of the panel.
Video showing a multimeter test of the panel's output in sunlight.
Close-up photos of the frame corners to check for previous mounting marks or wear.
response.reason: The brand and wattage are the primary value drivers and cannot be verified from a front-facing photo. 500W is an atypical rating for a 120-cell panel, which usually ranges between 370W and 415W.
